details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py:2987-2992, 3040-3052, 3077-3084 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Git authentication embeds GH_TOKEN directly in HTTPS clone URLs after removal of per-process http.extraHeader authentication.
  WHY: Tokens can appear in process arguments, persisted `.git/config` remotes, Git diagnostics, and telemetry.

- scripts/memory_helpers.sh:581-585 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Force-tick remote URL construction embeds the GitHub token as HTTPS userinfo.
  WHY: Clone, push, and diagnostic paths can expose the token through argv, `.git/config`, and Git output.

- scripts/memory_helpers.sh:137-180 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Memory branch Git operations use bare `git` after `_memory_git` and its per-call authentication were removed.
  WHY: With `persist-credentials: false`, private-repository `ls-remote` and push operations run without credentials and fail.

- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:152-167, 241-245 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Sensitive-path filtering and post-resolution checks were removed from caller-supplied targeted paths.
  WHY: Issue- or plan-derived paths such as `.env`, `.git/config`, `.ssh/id_rsa`, or symlinks into sensitive locations can be read into model prompts.

- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:668 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Diagnose runs `codex --sandbox danger-full-access` directly without the model-provider broker while credentials remain available.
  WHY: Issue-derived diagnostic input can access secrets, mutate the workspace, and use the public provider outside the former read-only isolation boundary.

- scripts/codex_helpers.sh:135-525 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The shared `model_provider_broker_*` lifecycle and execution functions were removed while production callers remain.
  WHY: Model-execution phases fail with `command not found` before Codex starts, and the brokered credential-isolation boundary is removed.

- scripts/write_codex_config.sh:95-114 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `--provider-base-url` and its loopback validation were removed while five callers still pass the option.
  WHY: Config generation exits on an unknown argument; the hard-coded public URL would also bypass the loopback broker.

- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:493-498 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `git_with_github_auth` was deleted while `review_rb_judge.sh` still calls it.
  WHY: Judge-fix and baseline pushes fail with `command not found` or lack authenticated Git access.

- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:947-1352 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The `review_blocked_*` approval, decision, successor, and marker helper family was deleted while callers remain.
  WHY: Review-blocked terminal decisions cannot publish or consume human approvals and can stall or fail closed.

- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:768-769, 913-922 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Normalized PR-comment payloads no longer include `id`, `author_id`, `author_type`, or `author_association`.
  WHY: Approval verification cannot authenticate producer comments or authorize approvers, and comment-thread mapping loses required identity fields.

- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh:7, 52-63 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `--process-group-file` was removed while isolated editor callers and tests still pass it.
  WHY: The stall guard exits with an unknown-option error before launching the editor.

- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh:287-323, 367-372, 435-462 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Process identity and survivor verification were removed from isolated child-group cleanup.
  WHY: PID reuse or surviving `nobody` descendants can cause unrelated processes to be signaled or workspace ownership to be restored while children still mutate the worktree.

- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh:101-237 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The staged-support restore block is gated on `STAGED_SUPPORT_LEDGER` and `STAGED_SUPPORT_BASE_DIR`, which `.github/workflows/implement.yml` never exports.
  WHY: The protection against replacing branch-owned helpers with support-ref copies is dead code; moonshotai_kimi-k3 classified the resulting related transactional concern as unreachable.

- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh:201-209 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The `git merge-file` three-way merge was reported as using the wrong positional order.
  WHY: The reviewers stated that editor changes may be overwritten by stale support-ref content; moonshotai_kimi-k3 explicitly rejected this finding and said the merge order is correct.

- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh:121-224 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The staged-support restore loop modifies paths incrementally without rollback if a later path conflicts.
  WHY: A failed run can leave a partially restored worktree; moonshotai_kimi-k3 did not report this because the loop is unreachable dead code.

- .github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml:68-82, 88-143 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Git authentication variables configured in one workflow step are not propagated to later memory operations.
  WHY: Both checkouts use `persist-credentials: false`, so later bare Git operations use unauthenticated HTTPS origins; deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro identified the same missing authentication as a task gap.

- .github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml:88-143 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: `MEMORY_HELPERS_READY=1` was reported as being exported before helper staging completed.
  WHY: This could allow downstream steps to treat incomplete staging as successful; moonshotai_kimi-k3 rejected this, stating the export is reached only after the loop succeeds.

- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:536-716 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Missing-file, binary, and overflow markers do not advance `used_bytes`, and the `MAX_TARGET_PATHS` cap was removed.
  WHY: Untrusted path lists can produce output beyond `TARGETED_FILE_CONTEXT_MAX_BYTES` and consume the model context budget.

- tests/test_targeted_file_context.py:30,37 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Tests import `MAX_TARGET_PATHS` and `is_sensitive_target_path`, which were removed.
  WHY: Pytest collection fails with `ImportError` before the targeted-file-context tests execute.

- tests/test_codex_stall_guard_scripts.py:481,593,654,745,772 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Stall-guard tests still invoke the removed `--process-group-file` option.
  WHY: The tests fail with an unknown-option error and no longer cover the process-group termination contract.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

  expected_change_site: scripts/codex_helpers.sh, scripts/gh_helpers.sh, scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh, scripts/write_codex_config.sh, scripts/ai_memory_lib.py, scripts/memory_helpers.sh, scripts/targeted_file_context.py, scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  EVIDENCE: Broker, Git-auth, review-blocked, provider-base-url, sensitive-path, path-cap, process-group, and per-process Git-auth interfaces were removed or altered in scripts/codex_helpers.sh, scripts/gh_helpers.sh, scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh, scripts/write_codex_config.sh, scripts/ai_memory_lib.py, scripts/memory_helpers.sh, scripts/targeted_file_context.py, and scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh.

  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml — the earlier Configure git auth step that set up Git authentication for downstream memory operations

- requirement: "Add repository-wide regression coverage to prevent mutable action or helper references from returning."
  expected_change_site: tests/test_workflow_checkout_integration_ref_audit.py and/or a new contract test asserting the exported shared-helper API surface
  confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  EVIDENCE: tests/test_workflow_checkout_integration_ref_audit.py covers workflow action SHAs, but no test asserts the broker, Git-auth, review-blocked, sensitive-path, provider-base-url, process-group-file, or path-cap interfaces.

- requirement: "Fix every instance of each finding's defect class across this project's changes, not only the cited line."
  expected_change_site: scripts/memory_helpers.sh, scripts/ai_memory_lib.py, scripts/targeted_file_context.py, scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh, scripts/gh_helpers.sh, scripts/codex_helpers.sh, scripts/write_codex_config.sh, scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  EVIDENCE: Credential-in-URL Git auth, direct-credentialed model execution, secret-inlinable prompt context, removed approval-auth fields, and removed shared interfaces remain across the cited files.
